newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain arrests 3 over attack on Russian consulate.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain arrests 3 over attack on Russian consulate.

text.p: Bahrain has arrested three men in connection with a shooting attack on a policeman guarding the Russian consulate last month, newspapers reported on Sunday.
The guard was seriously wounded, they said.

An Interior Ministry official named the three as Mohammed Abd-Ali Jassim Isa, Mohammed Reda Murtada and Farahat Khorsheed. He said the attackers tried to seize the policeman's weapon, the newspapers reported.
They quoted the official as saying the three confessed and would be tried in the State Security Court.
The papers did not give the guard's nationality.
